notes.content:
Now We...? Uh never mind about it.
I am making new 3d free maps have [strike]awesome[/strike] lights and atmosphere, but the release could not be fast.

Now I am making new 3d horror fps game. Because of that, I can't spend my all time on this game.
Anyway updates will be go on. plz wait.

notes.title: 1.0.1 version is released and about trading cards
notes.content:
[1.0.1 patch notes]

Now only true ending exists, normal ending is deleted.
Added more savepoints

--

1.0.0 save data could not be work on 1.0.1.
If you have problems, try 1.0.0 version.


[About trading cards]
Maybe steam will not allow trading cards on this game, so I removed "Trading cards system" on shop. (Displaying "Trading cards system" on shop was also steam glitch)

If you bought this game to collect trading cards, request refund to steam.
When steam do not accept, please contact me.
